text:
maya: Hey team — I pushed a consolidated remediation tracker for the authz postmortem: https://tiny.redwood/pm-remediate (sheet has task owners + rough ETAs). Main asks: confirm ownership for each row, call out any blockers, and add timeline by EOD tomorrow.

tom: I can own ServiceAccount credential rotation (row 3). ETA ~2026-04-06. Need clarity: does this include legacy CI service accounts?

kai: I’ll take audit-logging improvements (row 5). Will add structured logs for token validation failures and an index on log-level. Targeting EOD Fri. Example log filter I’ll add:```json
{"event":"token_validation","result":"fail","service":"*"}
```

alex: +1 on including KMS key rotation in the scope for credential rotation. We discovered one key without rotation policy in the audit. If tom’s owning SA rotation, can you also confirm KMS key mapping?

ops-bot: Created tasks: PM-4823 (cred-rotation), PM-4824 (audit-logs), PM-4825 (runbook updates). Link: https://tracker.redwood/PM-4823

maya: Thanks. tom — can you annotate which SAs are legacy vs. current in the tracker so we can prioritize? alex — if you can attach the KMS mapping to PM-4823 that helps. I’ll mark rows as "in-progress" once owners ack. Also flagging a recurring pattern we saw across postmortems: missing TTL checks on ephemeral tokens (we should consider a quarterly sweep).

tom: acked. I added a new column "legacy_flag" and marked 6 SAs as legacy. I put a note: legacy SAs require migration plan before rotation. Starting a PR later today: https://git.redwood/pr/1189

kai: added a sample query to the sheet that surfaces token-validation-fail spikes and service owner. Will wire up an alert after PM-4824 is scoped. Also assigning runbook update to myself — will add steps to triage token failures + quick rollback.

alex: uploaded KMS mapping to PM-4823 comments. Quick ask: do we want to rotate keys immediately for the affected key or schedule within maintenance window? Security recommends rotation in the next 7 days unless it's blocking a production flow.

sara: From compliance POV, please add the compliance tags and retention justification to each PM ticket (GDPR/CCPA tags). I’ll sign off once tags are present.

maya: Good catch, sara. I added a "compliance_tags" column in the sheet. Owners — add tags before you mark complete. Also scheduling a 30m sync on Thu 09:30 PT to walk through blockers; invite sent.

tom: PR 1189 opened, CI green except one flake. Pinged @lena for review. Marked PM-4823 as in-progress. I annotated which services need migration docs.

kai: Runbook draft pushed to docs repo: https://docs.redwood/runbooks/token-validation.md — will iterate after Thu sync.

maya: If anyone hits a blocker that affects customer-facing traffic, add the "blocking" label in tracker and ping #eng-oncall. We want automatic escalation for anything that risks SLA.

tom: quick question on scope: do we rotate service tokens for third-party integrations (Zoom, analytics) in this ticket or create separate follow-ups?

alex: Separate follow-up preferred. For now, mark those as "3rd-party:review" in the tracker; create PM-4826 if rotation required.

maya: thanks — created PM-4826 for 3rd-party token review.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: weekly-checkpoint created for PM-4823 & PM-4824 every Wed 10:00 PT, invites to owners.

tom: Ack, will attend weekly checkpoint.

kai: Ack, will update alert thresholds ahead of checkpoint.

maya: Perfect — wrapping up here. Please update the sheet when you make changes and drop any docs/PRs in the tracker comments. Catch up Thu 09:30 PT. :thumbsup:
